description: 한국동서발전(주)_연간소내전력량 조회 서비스 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국동서발전(주). 이 데이터는 발전 설비별로 구분된 중분류, 호기, 설비용량(kW), 송전량(kWh), 연도, 사업소 등 핵심 지표를 포함하고 있어 발전소별 성능 변화, 설비별 운용 실적, 자원 활용. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국동서발전(주). Its tags are 연간송전량, 발전설비, 송전실적, 성능분석, 기술연구. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
